cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Every Glitch Is a Gift
cards.instruction: Turn every contradiction or failure into a surprising benefit of the impossible system.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: The garden door opens into the broom cupboard. Excellent, we can collect a brush for the picnic crumbs. Pass it handle first.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Now it's the attic. I've got both hands full of sandwiches.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll hold those. Fetch the blanket, folded rather than dragged. This door has saved you the stairs.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Now it's the cellar, and the sandwiches are getting warm.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Perfect refrigeration. Put them beside the wine, lids closed please. We'll use the door's catering service before we find the garden.

reason: Respond to B's actual occupied hands and later temperature problem while making each wrong destination a useful picnic step under supervision.
